findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_discovery, get_product, get_order_questions, get_recap, get_order_status · Private data: get_artwork_spec, submit_artwork, start_order_intent, get_order_questions, create_order, get_order_status · Public sink: get_product, submit_artwork, start_order_intent, get_order_questions, get_recap, create_order, get_order_status · Destructive: get_artwork_spec, submit_artwork.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_discovery, get_product, get_order_questions, get_recap, get_order_status · Private data: get_artwork_spec, submit_artwork, start_order_intent, get_order_questions, create_order, get_order_status · Public sink: get_product, submit_artwork, start_order_intent, get_order_questions, get_recap, create_order, get_order_status · Destructive: get_artwork_spec, submit_artwork

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
